ETH fund flows turn to net outflows | About $29.1 million on November 17 | 1825 not breached: protect positions first

My stance is cautious in the short term; first, I want to see whether outflows ease. The newly updated Farside table for U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs shows total net outflows of about $29.1 million on November 17. BlackRock's ETHA saw outflows of about $27.6 million, ETHB about $2.8 million, and Bitwise's ETHW saw inflows of about $1.3 million; all others were listed at zero. Total outflows on November 16 were about $8.4 million. These are fund flow records aggregated by trading day. The webpage updates automatically, and figures may be revised later; they are not the same as every sell order in the spot market right now.

Why is this more worth watching than “how much ETH ETF a particular institution holds”? 13F filings or quarterly reports show holdings at a particular point in the past and may not become public for weeks; daily fund net flows are closer to current subscription and redemption pressure in the primary market. The two figures use different methodologies and cannot be subtracted to derive institutions' net direction. The previously reported quarterly holdings at Goldman Sachs and quarter-end pledged fund amounts at Morgan Stanley cannot offset the November 17 net outflows. On the other hand, $29.1 million in a single day is not enough on its own to determine the market trend relative to ETH's overall market cap and trading volume. We need to watch whether the outflows continue and whether prices can absorb them.

How has the market reacted so far? At the time of checking, ETH/USD on Kraken was about $1,809.74, with an opening price of about $1,822.67 and an intraday range of $1,795.05 to $1,824.36; its 24-hour range was about $1,749.17 to $1,833.48. ETH did not immediately break below its intraday low after the fund table was updated, but it also did not reclaim 1825. Strictly speaking, this does not prove that ETF outflows caused today's price moves; macro risk appetite, exchange inventories, and derivatives positioning may also affect prices. My view is that when flows are weak, we should not add to positions based solely on the idea that “the price won't fall” before a breakout is confirmed.

The first key level to watch is $1,825, near the day's high. After a breakout, we also need to see whether ETH can hold above $1,835 before it has a chance to test $1,850. On the downside, $1,800 is a short-term psychological level and $1,795 is the day's low; a break below that could put the $1,750 area back in focus. If ETF flows turn from outflows to consecutive net inflows and ETH holds firmly above $1,835, I will reverse my current cautious stance. Conversely, if ETH breaks below $1,795 and fund outflows continue, I'll manage risk first rather than use long-term bullish narratives to resist the immediate pressure on positions.

If I were trading myself, I would sit out for now and only consider a small spot long. The entry trigger would be ETH holding above $1,835 for an hour and then retesting $1,825 without breaking below it, with fund flows not deteriorating significantly further on the next trading day. If these conditions are met, I would risk no more than 3% of my total capital on a trial position. I would take half off at the first target of $1,850 and reduce the position further at the second target of $1,880; I would close the remainder if ETH fell back to $1,835. The initial stop-loss would be below $1,815, with the entire position closed if triggered. If ETH first breaks below $1,795, I would cancel the long plan and remain in cash. The expected loss on a single trade would be around 0.1% or less of total capital. I would not use high leverage; conditions that have not been triggered are only part of the plan, not executed trades or profits.

#ETH
The above is solely my personal market observation and does not constitute investment advice.

content:
ETH基金流量转为净流出｜11月17日约2910万美元｜1825未突破先守仓位

我的态度是短线谨慎，先看资金端是否止血。刚更新的Farside美国现货以太坊ETF表格显示，11月17日合计净流出约2910万美元；其中贝莱德ETHA约流出2760万美元、ETHB约流出280万美元，Bitwise ETHW约流入130万美元，其余列为零。11月16日合计约流出840万美元。这是按交易日汇总的基金资金记录，网页会自动更新，后续可能修订；它并不等于今天此刻现货盘面的每一笔卖单。

为什么这比“某家机构持有多少ETH ETF”更值得盯？13F或季报披露的是过去某一时点的持仓存量，可能经过数周才公开；每日基金净流量更接近当前一级市场的申赎压力。两者口径不能相减得出机构净方向。前面看到的高盛季度持仓、摩根士丹利基金季末质押规模，都不能抵消11月17日这组净流出。另一方面，单日2910万美元放在ETH整体市值和交易量里也不是足以独自决定行情的数字，需要观察是否连续，以及价格能否消化。

市场已经如何反应？查询时Kraken ETH/USD约1809.74美元，当日开盘约1822.67，日内在1795.05至1824.36美元之间震荡；过去24小时区间约1749.17至1833.48美元。ETH没有因基金表格更新而立即跌穿日内低点，也没有重新站上1825。严格说不能证明是ETF流出导致今天这段价格变化，同期宏观风险偏好、交易所库存和衍生品仓位都可能影响报价。我的判断是，资金偏弱时，价格没有确认突破前不应只凭“跌不动”去加仓。

关键位先看1825美元，这对应当日高点附近；突破后还要看1835美元能否站稳，才有机会试探1850。下方1800是短线心理位，1795是当日低点，失守后风险可能重新指向1750附近。若接下来ETF数据由流出转为连续净流入、ETH有效站稳1835，我会推翻目前的谨慎判断；反之若跌破1795且资金继续外流，先处理风险，不用远期升级叙事抵抗眼前的仓位压力。

如果是我自己交易，现在不参与，方向只考虑现货轻仓做多。入场触发是ETH在1835美元上方收稳一小时并回踩1825不破，且下一交易日基金流量没有继续显著恶化；满足后总资金最多3%试仓。第一目标1850美元减仓一半，第二目标1880美元继续减仓，余仓跌回1835全部平仓。初始止损设在1815美元下方，触及即全退；若先跌破1795美元就取消做多计划，继续空仓。单笔预期亏损约占总资金0.1%以内，不用高杠杆；未触发的条件只是计划，不算成交或盈利。

#ETH
以上仅为个人市场观察，不构成投资建议。

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

translatedData.title: What's the difference between isolated and cross margin? Which should beginners use?
translatedData.subTitle:
When opening a futures position, you'll be asked to choose between “isolated margin” and “cross margin.” Many beginners just click without thinking and end up taking a big loss.

【Cross margin】Your entire account balance is used as margin. Advantage: the liquidation price is farther away, so you're less likely to get liquidated;
Downside: in an extreme market, losses could wipe out your entire account. It's like putting all your eggs in one basket.
They prop one another up in the same basket.

【Isolated margin】Only a specified amount of money is allocated to this position. If it gets liquidated, you can lose at most that amount,
and the loss won't spread to your other positions or principal. The risk is locked in a cage.

【My advice】Beginners should always use isolated margin. The reason is simple: you aren't yet able to assess the worst-case outcome of a single bad trade

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

DBS Bank and Circle open a direct channel for institutions to mint and redeem USDC

Singapore’s banking sector is moving from planning to implementation in the on-chain dollar space. On November 18, DBS Bank and stablecoin issuer Circle announced a partnership to strengthen Asia’s stablecoin infrastructure and expand institutional clients’ access to the US dollar stablecoin USDC. The announcement came shortly after DBS Bank launched an interbank tokenized deposit service with Kinexys, a JPMorgan subsidiary, with Ant International as its first client. With two moves in quick succession, the bank is clearly accelerating its on-chain finance efforts.

The key change is in access: eligible institutional clients in Asia will be able to mint and redeem USDC directly through DBS Bank, without having to buy or sell it on secondary markets such as crypto exchanges, reducing their reliance on secondary-market liquidity. The service is backed by round-the-clock, near-instant settlement between US dollars and USDC, allowing institutions to move funds between fiat currencies and on-chain assets outside traditional banking hours. One point needs clarification: USDC will continue to be issued by a regulated entity under Circle, while DBS Bank provides the banking channel and liquidity management. The service is limited to eligible institutional clients and is not currently available to retail users.

Breaking down the rationale, direct minting and redemption address two major pain points for institutional stablecoin users: uncertainty around secondary-market liquidity and the constraints of banking hours. Evy Theunis, head of digital assets in DBS Bank’s institutional banking group, said the future of financial services would be multimodal and involve multiple tools, with different forms of tokenized money serving different needs. Circle Chief Business Officer Kash Razzaghi said the partnership was an important step toward expanding institutional access to USDC in Asia and strengthening the banking infrastructure needed to support its global adoption. The partnership is also rooted in both companies’ participation in Project Bloom, led by the Monetary Authority of Singapore, which explores the secure, seamless and scalable use of tokenized money.

The impact on the crypto market is likely to be concentrated in institutional access and infrastructure. Opening up the banking channel could, in theory, reduce the operational friction for Asian institutions seeking access to on-chain dollars and provide a smoother route for USDC adoption in areas such as corporate treasury management and cross-border settlement. Meanwhile, according to a third-party data platform, USDC’s circulating market capitalization was about $69.3 billion as of November 18, making it the world’s second-largest US dollar stablecoin, but it had fallen about 4.5% over the previous 30 days. The total global stablecoin market capitalization also contracted over the same period, meaning infrastructure expansion is taking place alongside a shrinking supply. A corporate survey cited by DBS Bank found that 88% of large companies surveyed had deployed or piloted tokenized money, while more than 60% had adopted or planned to adopt stablecoins, indicating a solid basis for institutional demand.

Overall, the development is more significant as a signal of financial infrastructure investment than for its short-term market impact. Variables to watch include actual usage of direct minting and redemption, the pace of adoption among institutional clients in Asia, and whether tokenized deposits and stablecoins can interoperate across networks. If institutional adoption continues to deepen, competition in the on-chain dollar market may shift from a simple contest over circulation size to one focused on how efficiently bank accounts, corporate funds and blockchain networks can be connected. It should be emphasized that this assessment of the competitive landscape is editorial speculation; the actual impact will depend on business data. This article does not constitute investment advice.

#星展银行与Circle扩大亚洲机构USDC准入 #BTC #ETH #BNB

content:
星展银行与Circle打通渠道 机构可直接铸造赎回USDC

新加坡银行业在链上美元领域的布局正走向落地。11月18日，星展银行与稳定币发行商Circle宣布合作，加强亚洲稳定币基础设施，扩大机构客户对美元稳定币USDC的接入。此次公告前，星展银行刚与摩根大通旗下Kinexys推出跨银行代币化存款服务，蚂蚁国际成为首家客户，两天内接连落子，链上金融动作明显提速。

核心事实在于渠道之变：符合条件的亚洲机构客户，今后可直接通过星展银行完成USDC的铸造与赎回，无需再到交易平台等二级市场买卖，从而分散对二级市场流动性的依赖。该服务由全天候、近乎即时的美元与USDC结算能力支撑，机构可在传统银行营业时间之外，自由调配法币与链上资产之间的资金。需要厘清的是：USDC仍由Circle旗下受监管实体发行，星展银行提供的是银行端通道与流动性管理；服务仅限合格机构客户，暂不面向普通个人用户。

从逻辑上拆解，直接铸造与赎回回应了机构使用稳定币的两大痛点：一是二级市场流动性的不确定，二是银行营业时间的限制。星展银行机构银行业务部数字资产主管Evy Theunis表示，金融服务的未来将是多模式、多工具的，不同形式的代币化货币将满足不同需求。Circle首席商务官Kash Razzaghi称，这是扩大亚洲机构USDC接入、强化其全球采用所需银行基础设施的重要一步。该合作亦植根于双方共同参与的新加坡金融管理局牵头的Project Bloom项目，该项目探索代币化货币的安全、无缝与可扩展使用。

对加密市场的影响路径，主要集中在机构准入与基础设施层面。银行渠道打通后，理论上降低了亚洲机构获取链上美元的操作摩擦，为USDC在企业资金管理、跨境结算等场景的落地提供更顺畅的入口。同时，据第三方统计平台11月18日数据，USDC流通市值约693亿美元，为全球第二大美元稳定币，但过去30日下降约4.5%，同期全球稳定币总市值亦在收缩，基础设施扩张与供给收缩正在并存。星展银行引述的企业调查显示，88%的受访大型企业已部署或试行代币化货币，逾六成已采用或计划采用稳定币，机构需求具备现实基础。

综合来看，此事的实际意义大于短期行情意义，属于金融机构基础设施建设信号。后续值得跟踪的变量包括：直接铸造与赎回的实际使用量、亚洲机构客户的采用节奏、以及代币化存款与稳定币两类工具能否实现跨网络互通。若机构采用持续深化，链上美元市场的竞争焦点，可能从单纯的流通规模之争，转向银行账户、企业资金与区块链网络之间的连接效率之争。需要强调，上述竞争格局判断属于编辑推测，具体影响仍需以实际业务数据为准，本文不构成任何投资建议。

$SOPH: Understanding Humility in Crypto Market Research

$SOPH: SOPH shows an hourly upward direction while volume sits above baseline. How can analysts avoid overstating confidence when the data is limited?

The tempting shortcut is to treat the observed rise and the 3.82x baseline as a clear sign of market strength. This interpretation often leans on social proof, where others repeat the same narrative without checking the underlying constraints. A more careful reading notes that the volume metric only tells us that activity exceeds a recent average; it does not reveal the source, intent, or sustainability of that activity. The observation also includes an RSI 58.9 reading, which provides a snapshot of momentum but cannot alone confirm a trend.

A useful next observation would be a closed daily candle that shows a change -7.14286% and a shift in the RSI value. If the daily change is modest and the RSI moves toward a neutral range, the earlier optimism should be tempered. Conversely, a stronger daily move coupled with an RSI that moves further into overbought territory could justify revisiting the initial confidence.

To separate evidence from persuasion, readers should ask: what new data would weaken the current view? A future candle that closes lower despite the hourly rise, or a drop in the relative volume ratio, would signal that the earlier signal was perhaps a short‑term fluctuation. By consistently checking for such counter‑evidence, analysts can maintain humility and avoid letting social proof drive premature conclusions.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

Watchlist contrast: $ETH has hourly direction up and volume not above its baseline; $ZIL has hourly direction up and volume above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.

title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100 USDT control 1,000 USDT, and what's the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are just getting started ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I'll explain it in plain English.

[The basics] Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100 USDT and use 10x leverage, you're actually controlling a
1,000 USDT position. If the coin price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your capital; conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your capital—note that the loss is calculated based on your total borrowed position.

[The cost] With 10x leverage, if the coin price moves against you by about 10%, your capital is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It doesn't mean
you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact point also depends on the margin ratio).

title: 交易干货 | 满仓一把梭的数学期望，看完你还敢吗
subTitle:
假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All-In—Would You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% when you’re right and losing 50% when you’re wrong. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all-in every time, let’s calculate the long-term result: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
It looks like a positive expected value. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean -75%, and you need to gain 300% to break even.
A positive expected value strategy + going all-in = a high probability of ruin. This is the gambler’s ruin theorem playing out in crypto
every day.

Take the same strategy, but use only 20% of your position each time: two losses in a row mean -18%, barely a scratch,
and you still get the same long-term expected return. The strategy didn’t change—only your position size did. The outcome is life or death.

ETH is currently at $ 1749.25, down 15.8% over 7 days and 2.8% over 24 hours; the Fear & Greed Index is just 11, with a weekly average of 14, and ETH is down 65% from its ATH. What this calls into question isn’t “whether ETH can still rise,” but whether panic automatically creates a buying opportunity.

Last week, I judged that sentiment was near an extreme and, with trading volume active, expected a quick recovery. I got the timing wrong: some people were participating, but no one was willing to push prices higher right away.

Two business developments are especially worth revisiting. CoinShares has cleared ETH from its treasury, selling it for $19.3 million and using up nearly half of its $40 million buyback authorization. Corporate ETH purchases don’t necessarily mean long-term holdings. This could put pressure on treasury holders and affect capital whose business models rely on staking yields.

On the other hand, BlackRock’s staked ETH ETF can share in priority fees paid by traders, but the risk of criminal enforcement over MEV remains unresolved following an acquittal. In practice, staking yields are still constrained by legal boundaries: protocols and ETF operators want a share of the upside, but users and valuation models may ultimately bear the compliance costs. Whether this business model can work isn’t something you can judge by yield alone.

My view has changed: for now, I’m watching trading volume, the Fear & Greed Index, and whether institutional treasury selling spreads. Do you think ETH is bottoming out, or has the institutional retreat already begun?

I remain cautious and prefer to wait and see. The filing is very clear: Both products had already been approved for listing and trading on the exchange. This change allows them to continue trading under the exchange’s previously approved generic listing standards for commodity-based trust shares. The SEC agreed to waive the usual 30-day operative delay so that the existing products could remain listed, and because the change does not raise any new regulatory issues. So I classify this as a listing-rule adjustment for existing products—not the launch of a new product, approval of staking, or a sudden institutional purchase of ETH. Chasing a rally just because you see the words “SEC,” “Ethereum ETF,” and “effective immediately” leaves out the most important part of the logic: verifying the actual flows.

Market prices also offer no strong confirmation: I just checked Binance ETH/USDT at around $1,749.9, down about 2.65% over 24 hours, with a low of $1,732.83 and a high of $1,836. title: 止损到底该挂哪？技术位和百分比，我这样选
subTitle:
止损挂在哪儿，比设不设止损更讲究。挂太近天天被扫，挂太远一次亏麻。

【固定百分比法】比如每次亏本金的1%-2%就离场。简单粗暴，适合新手
建立纪律。缺点是不看结构，可能正好挂在别人的止损堆里。

【技术位止损法】挂在结构失效的位置：做多挂关键支撑下方，做空挂
压力位上方。逻辑是——这个位置破了，说明我看错的证据出现了。
配合仓位反推：止损距离大，就把仓位调小，保证单笔亏损还是本金的
1%-2%。这才是「止损位定仓位」的正确顺序。

【我最常用的组合】技术位定方向失效点，仓位保命。两者一合并，你
会发现：止损宽的交易，仓位自然就该小；止损近的交易才能放大点仓位。
顺序千万别反——先定仓位再找止损，是大多数人亏钱的根源。

translatedData.title: Where should you place a stop-loss? How I choose between technical levels and percentages
translatedData.subTitle:
Where you place your stop-loss matters more than whether you set one. Too close and you get stopped out every day; too far and one loss can wipe you out.

【Fixed-Percentage Method】For example, exit whenever you lose 1%–2% of your capital. Simple and straightforward, suitable for beginners
and helps build discipline. The downside is that it ignores market structure, so your stop may end up right in a cluster of other traders’ stop-losses.

【Technical-Level Stop-Loss Method】Place it where the structure is invalidated: for a long position, below key support; for a short position, place it
above resistance. The logic is—if this level breaks, it means evidence has emerged that I was wrong.
Work backward from your position size: if the stop-loss distance is large, reduce your position size to keep the loss on any single trade at a set percentage of your capital.

Gobernador de la Fed: La financiación tokenizada todavía depende de los bancos tradicionales

El gobernador de la Reserva Federal, Christopher Waller, abordó dos temas separados en comentarios recientes: un posible aumento del tipo de interés de 50 puntos básicos si la inflación sigue siendo persistente y los límites estructurales de los pagos basados en blockchain.

En cuanto a las finanzas tokenizadas, Waller argumentó que los sistemas de pago blockchain aún no pueden operar independientemente de la infraestructura de liquidación tradicional. Señaló la necesidad de medidas de protección más estrictas antes de que los sistemas financieros descentralizados puedan escalar, posicionando a los bancos como un componente necesario en lugar de un obstáculo para su sustitución.

以太坊市场深度分析：多重利空叠加但超卖反弹一触即发

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十八日北京时间凌晨三点，以太坊现货价格报一千七百五十六美元，过去二十四小时内下跌约百分之一点一五。价格日内最低触及一千七百三十二美元，随后出现技术性反弹。从小时级别K线来看，以太坊的价格走势明显弱于比特币，跌幅更大且反弹力度更弱。

以太坊当前面临多重利空因素。首先是黑客钱包的持续抛售压力，约七万八千四百一十五枚以太坊被转移至去中心化交易所进行抛售，这种大规模的清算行为对市场情绪造成了严重打击。其次，现货以太坊ETF持续录得净流出，仅十一月十七日单日净流出就达到两千九百一十万美元。企业持仓方面也有清算动作，约一千六百六十万美元的机构持仓被平仓。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统方面，七日移动均线位于一千七百六十三美元，二十五日均线位于一千七百九十五美元，九十九日均线位于一千八百零七美元。价格已经跌穿所有主要均线，空头排列格局明确。指数移动均线同样呈现空头排列，七日指数移动均线在一千七百六十七美元附近，二十五日指数移动均线在一千七百八十八美元附近。

布林带指标显示上轨在一千八百三十三美元，中轨在一千七百九十一美元，下轨在一千七百四十八美元。当前价格已经跌破布林带下轨，处于极端超卖状态。MACD指标运行在零轴下方，MACD值为负十三点四四，信号线为负九点三三，柱状图为负四点一二，空头动能仍在持续但柱状图有收窄迹象。

RSI六周期指标报三十二点一六，较前一小时的二十九点一六有所回升，但仍然处于偏低区域。十二周期RSI报三十四点五零，二十四周期RSI报三十九点五三。KDJ指标中K值三十四点一七，D值三十二点五六，J值三十七点四一，三线在低位区域呈现向上拐头的迹象。威廉指标报负七十点七一，处于超卖区域。抛物线SAR指标位于一千八百一十七美元，远高于当前价格，确认短期下行趋势。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场当前面临的最大不确定性来自于Glamsterdam升级的技术风险。核心开发者警告该升级可能破坏约一万五千个智能合约，因为拟议的更改将把每区块Gas容量从六千万提升至两亿。AI辅助审计发现约两百种合约类型可能受到更高Gas成本的影响。这一技术争议对以太坊生态系统的信心造成了不小的冲击。

从链上数据来看，黑客钱包的清算尚未完成，数万名以太坊的后续处置将继续对去中心化交易池造成滑点压力。近期多起借贷金库和跨链桥的安全事件也削弱了市场对去中心化金融收益的信心。不过，从综合信号指标来看，十五个因子中有十个发出做多信号，占比达到百分之六十六点六七。复合指标显示做多信号，历史胜率为百分之七十五。

超卖反弹的技术条件正在逐步成熟。小时级别RSI曾一度跌至八点九四的极端低位，随后反弹至三十八点二，这种剧烈的均值回归波动在 descending moving averages 下仍然具有较高的波动性。投资者需要密切关注一千七百四十八美元的布林带下轨支撑位，以及一千七百三十二美元的日内低点能否守住。

热门代币方面，MMT报价零点二四九九美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之七十九点六五；ZKC报价零点零三一二美元，涨幅百分之三十二点七七；SOPH报价零点零零一零五美元，涨幅百分之二十点六九。

title: 资金费率里藏着多空情绪，教你读三种典型状态
subTitle:
上次讲了资金费率的机制，今天讲怎么把它当情绪温度计用。

【状态一：费率持续高正】说明多头拥挤，大家都借钱做多。这时候行情
往往在加速赶顶阶段，随时可能来一次「多杀多」的急跌。不是让你立刻
做空，而是：这个阶段追多要格外小心，止损要收紧。

【状态二：费率持续负】空头拥挤。极端负费率经常出现在恐慌底部附近，
因为该跑的都跑了还在做空。历史上不少大反弹就起点在这种时候。

【状态三：费率在零附近晃】多空平衡，市场在等方向。这种时候趋势
策略最好歇着，区间思路或观望更合适。

【提醒】费率是温度计，不是方向盘。它告诉你现在谁挤，不告诉你下一
根K线涨跌。把它和你的技术面信号叠着看，别单独当买卖依据。

Last time, we covered how funding rates work. Today, we’ll look at how to use them as a sentiment gauge.

【State 1: Funding rates remain strongly positive】This means longs are crowded, with everyone borrowing money to go long. At this point, the market
is often accelerating toward a peak, and a sharp “long squeeze” could happen at any moment. That doesn’t mean you should immediately
Instead of shorting, be extra cautious about chasing longs at this stage, and tighten your stop-loss.

【State 2: Funding rates remain negative】Shorts are crowded. Extremely negative funding rates often occur near panic-driven bottoms,
because everyone who was going to run has already run, yet people are still shorting. Many major rallies in the past began at times like this.

title: BTC 6.3万、ETH 1765、黄金 3734：三个现在都不能直接进场，但只有一个值得提前埋伏
subTitle:
BTC、ETH和黄金合约买卖点分析
先说清楚一件事，因为大多数人在这里搞错：BTC 和 ETH 是同一个因子，黄金不是。BTC/ETH 吃的是美元流动性——10Y TIPS 实际收益率 2.92%（2008 年以来最高）、DXY 103.5（19 个月新高）、12 月加息概率 92%。ETH 只是 BTC 的放大器，所以这两个的方向永远一致，只有仓位大小不同。
黄金吃的是另一件事：央行购金。Q3 净购 321 吨，月均 60 吨 = 2022 年前的 3.5 倍。实际利率对黄金是负相关，所以黄金和 BTC 不是同一个赌注——这正是我敢给它们相反方向的全部理由。
但有一个场景三者会一起跌：流动性挤兑。2020 年 3 月、2022 年 11 月，黄金和 BTC 一起被强平。所以别用"买 BTC + 买 ETH + 买黄金"去分散尾部风险——那一天它们同向。

① BTC：63,000 —— 多空都是负期望
跌破 200 周均线，RSI6 连续 6 天超卖，但 MACD 没有底背离。更关键的是：63k 到 70k 需要净增 1,390 亿美元市值，而现货三条管道（ETF、稳定币、基差）全是负的——这笔钱只能来自杠杆，插针能到，站不住。
算过账：多单 −0.15R、空单 −0.19R、不建仓 0。0 比负数好。
条件空：反弹 64,800 / 66,700 / 68,500 分档，止损 70,400，目标 60,000 → 58,500。

② ETH：1,765 —— 不是超跌，是缺燃料
跌了 64%，很多人觉得"够便宜了"。但 ETH 的边际买盘 100% 来自场内稳定币，而稳定币市值 2,878 亿在缩。上方 2,089 是全口径成本，那一带全是解套盘。
条件空：反弹 1,806–1,819，止损 1,860，目标 1,700 → 1,650。任何情况不买。

③ 黄金：3,734 —— 技术最差，基本面最好
7 连阴、14 个月新低、COMEX 持仓 -41%（多头在跑）。但央行 Q3 净购 321 吨，月均 60 吨 = 2022 年前的 3.5 倍。
技术最差 + 基本面最好 = 现在不能持有，但该准备买。注意：这不是"赔率合格的机会"，而是用很小的风险买一个 12 月事件的期权——压力情形下 R:R 只有 1 左右。
两条路径，互斥：
▸ 路径 A：周线收回 3,700 且 COMEX 持仓止跌回升 → 3,700–3,740 买，止损 3,600，目标 3,820 / 3,880 / 3,900。
▸ 路径 B：周线破 3,600 之后不要在 3,600 接——那是双方共识位，最容易被插破。等 3,450–3,560 缩量止跌再分批，止损 3,380。

三条纪律（比方向重要）
1. 止损必须 ≥1 倍 ATR。小于 1 倍 ATR 的止损不是风控，是给市场送钱。ATR可以作为你以后止损依据，可以去完整学习一下。
2. 三笔不同时持有。
3. FOMC 前 48 小时、后 24 小时不开新仓。

最后一句话：恐惧贪婪 11，费率还是正的，多头还没投降——真正的底，通常出现在"费率转负 + 放量清算"那一天，而不是"跌得够多"那一天。

title: 资金费率是什么？为什么多头要给空头掏钱
subTitle:
玩永续合约绕不开一个词：资金费率。它每8小时结算一次，是多空之间
互相支付的一笔钱，交易所只是代收代付，不赚这个钱。

【机制】永续合约没有交割日，价格怎么和现货保持一致？就靠资金费率：
合约价高于现货价（多头情绪旺）→ 费率为正 → 多头付钱给空头；
合约价低于现货价（空头占优）→ 费率为负 → 空头付钱给多头。
钱在两边倒腾，把合约价格往现货价格上拽。

【代价】别小看这每8小时一笔：年化下来费率高的时候能到百分之几十。
做多时如果一直付高费率，就算方向看对了，利润也会被悄悄磨掉。

【一条实用习惯】开仓前看一眼当前费率。高正费率时追多，你在给空头
打工；极端负费率时追空，同理。费率不是方向指标，但它是成本，成本

translatedData.title: What is the funding rate? Why do longs have to pay shorts?
translatedData.subTitle:
There’s one term you can’t avoid when trading perpetual contracts: the funding rate. It’s settled every 8 hours and is
a payment made between longs and shorts. The exchange merely collects and distributes it; it doesn’t profit from it.

[Mechanism] Perpetual contracts have no settlement date. So how does their price stay in line with the spot price? The answer is the funding rate:
When the contract price is higher than the spot price (bullish sentiment is strong) → the funding rate is positive → longs pay shorts;
When the contract price is lower than the spot price (shorts are dominant) → the funding rate is negative → shorts pay longs.
Money changing hands between the two sides pulls the contract price toward the spot price.

title: 从保证金提醒到强平，中间发生了什么
subTitle:
强平不是一瞬间的事，它是一个流程。看懂这个流程，你就知道该在哪儿行动。

【第一步】初始保证金：开仓时占用的钱，比如10倍杠杆就是仓位的10%。
【第二步】行情反向走，保证金率上升。App开始弹「保证金不足」提醒，
这时候你还有选择：减仓降杠杆，或者补保证金。
【第三步】维持保证金线：亏损吃穿维持保证金要求，系统开始部分强平，
先平一部分回收风险，而不是一把全平。
【第四步】如果继续恶化，全部强平，你这笔仓位宣告结束。

【重点】从第二步的提醒到第三步的强平，中间是你最后的自救窗口。
但绝大多数人在这个时刻做的不是减仓，而是「再等等」「补点仓摊薄」——
把一个可控的小错误，拖成毁灭性的大错误。记住：提醒弹出来的时候，
正确的动作是减仓，不是加仓。

translatedData.title: What happens between a margin alert and liquidation?
translatedData.subTitle:
Liquidation doesn’t happen in an instant; it’s a process. Understand how it works, and you’ll know when to act.

[Step 1] Initial margin: The funds required to open a position. For example, at 10x leverage, it’s 10% of the position size.
[Step 2] The market moves against you, and your margin ratio rises. The app starts sending “Insufficient margin” alerts,
At this point, you still have options: reduce your position to lower leverage, or add more margin.
[Step 3] Maintenance margin level: Once losses eat into the maintenance margin requirement, the system starts partially liquidating your position,
closing part of it first to reduce risk, rather than closing it all at once.

Fed minutes just released | ETH pulls back to around 1,760 | Wait for risk to clear before talking about a rebound

My stance is not to buy the dip in ETH for now. Let the first wave of volatility after the minutes pass. The Fed has officially released the minutes of its October 27–28 FOMC meeting. The text shows that most participants at the meeting supported keeping the federal funds target range at 3.75% to 4%; however, in their outlook for the coming months, almost all participants thought that further rate increases might be appropriate under their baseline inflation and employment scenarios. A few participants also suggested that, if subsequent inflation data came in unfavorably, a rate hike of more than 25 basis points might need to be considered at the next meeting. It is important to distinguish the timing here: these are records of discussions at the October meeting, not a new rate-hike decision made on the evening of the November meeting, and certainly not confirmation that a 50-basis-point hike in December is a done deal.

Why do the minutes affect ETH? If higher rates stay in place for longer, the cost of dollar funding, long-term yields, and valuations of risk assets will all be repriced. In addition to being a crypto asset, ETH is also affected by on-chain financing, the relative appeal of staking yields, and institutional risk budgets. When risk appetite is tight, ETH may be more volatile than BTC. Conversely, if future data ease and bond yields fall, the market may recover, but that would need confirmation from future data and trading activity; it cannot be inferred directly from a historical set of minutes. Current hot topics on Binance Square are mostly Russian regulation, stablecoin channels, and hardware security—not new fundamental positives for ETH on a comparable scale.

After the minutes were released, I checked Binance ETH/USDT at around $1,759.68, down about 1.65% over 24 hours, with an intraday low of $1,732.83 and a high of $1,836. At the same time, BTC was around $62,876, down about 1.39% over 24 hours. A few minutes earlier, I saw ETH at around $1,762.58 and BTC at around $63,200; quotes continued to move lower afterward. This is an observation of the live market, and two quotes alone cannot establish that the minutes caused the entire move. First, watch whether ETH can hold $1,733, then whether it can reclaim $1,765 and $1,800. If BTC keeps falling below its intraday low area of $62,280, an ETH rebound on its own will be less reliable. If prices bounce quickly after the minutes but fail to retest and hold, I won't chase.

If I were trading this myself, I would stay out for now. I would only consider a leveraged-free spot long, with a maximum planned position size of 1% of total capital. If ETH falls below $1,732, I would close the entire position and cancel the long plan. I would reconsider my short-term recovery view if future inflation data come in stronger, the market raises its rate-hike expectations, or ETH remains unable to reclaim $1,765. First watch rate expectations and price action, then execute with a small position.

The trending headline says “plans to launch cross-border stablecoin prefunding in Asia Pacific.” Don’t take that to mean you can open your wallet today and use stablecoins to send money to anyone anywhere in Asia Pacific.

On November 18, Visa’s official press release said it plans to let eligible customers in Asia Pacific use supported stablecoins to prefund cross-border payments through Visa Direct; recipients will still receive fiat currency. Availability depends on eligibility and region. This is a way for businesses to prepare funds for payments—not a new “cross-border withdrawal” button in a personal exchange app.

A few points that are directly relevant to everyday users 👇

🔹 This is currently a pilot—not a rollout across all of Asia Pacific of the system already in full commercial production in the US. In October this year, Visa Direct’s stablecoin prefunding entered commercial production in the US with Inyo Global. In Asia Pacific, Visa says it is running a pilot with Singapore-based payments company dtcpay.

🔹 In its own announcement that same day, dtcpay said it holds a Major Payment Institution (MPI) licence issued by the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS), and that the pilot uses USDC for prefunding. It is aimed at business customers that frequently make cross-border payments, such as platforms, remittance providers, marketplaces, and payroll services. Payout options include US and Hong Kong bank accounts, eligible Visa cards, and supported digital wallets. Visa’s own Asia Pacific announcement did not name a specific stablecoin, referring only to “supported stablecoins.”

🔹 Visa also made clear that it does not provide regulated digital asset services; those services are provided independently to customers by licensed partners. Official details on fees, the full list of available regions, and whether everyday users can access this payment channel have not yet been published.

So when you see the words “launch in Asia Pacific,” think of an expanded pilot for business payment channels—not “you can already send stablecoins to anyone.” Business customers should ask their payment service provider whether they are eligible to participate. For individuals, recipients will still receive fiat currency, and this is nowhere near a full-scale launch yet.

Would you first keep an eye on where the pilot can send money, or wait until it moves from pilot to general availability?

#Visa拟在亚太推出稳定币跨境预注资 #BTC #ETH

content:
热榜上写「拟在亚太推出稳定币跨境预注资」，先别理解成：你今天打开钱包，就能用稳定币给亚太任意一个人打一笔款。

11月18日，Visa 官方新闻稿说的是：计划让亚太地区符合条件的客户，用支持的稳定币，通过 Visa Direct 为跨境付款做预注资；收款人收到的仍是法币。能不能用，因资格和地区而异。这是面向企业付款的资金准备方式，不是个人在交易所 App 里新开的一个「跨境提币」按钮。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 现在是试点，不是把美国已经量产的那套直接铺到整个亚太。今年10月，Visa Direct 的稳定币预注资已在美国与 Inyo Global 进入商业生产；亚太这边，Visa 写明正与新加坡支付公司 dtcpay 开展试点。

🔹 dtcpay 同日官方说明：自己持有新加坡金管局（MAS）颁发的主要支付机构（MPI）牌照，试点里用 USDC 做预注资。面向的是平台、汇款机构、市场和发薪服务这类经常要跨境打款的企业客户。出款方式包括：打到美国和香港的银行账户、打到符合条件的 Visa 卡，以及支持的数字钱包。Visa 自己的亚太稿没有点名具体稳定币，只用了「支持的稳定币」。

🔹 Visa 还写明：自己不提供受监管的数字资产服务，相关能力由持牌合作方独立提供给客户。手续费、完整可用地区、普通人能不能走这条通道，官方都还没列出来。

所以，看到「亚太推出」四个字，先当成企业付款通道的试点扩围，别按「已经能给任何人打稳定币」去安排自己的转账。企业客户要问自己的支付服务商有没有资格接入；个人这边，收款人拿到的仍会是法币，而且现在还谈不上全面开通。

你会先盯试点到底能打到哪些地方，还是等它从试点变成正式开放再关心？

In-Depth Analysis of the Ethereum Market: Weak, Range-Bound Trading Under the Double Pressure of Hacker Sell-Offs and ETF Outflows

I. Price Trend Analysis

As of 17:00 UTC on November 18, 2026, Ethereum was trading at $1,779.84, down approximately 1.2% over the past 24 hours. On the hourly candlestick chart, ETH weakened steadily over the past five trading sessions from around $1,790, hitting a low of $1,732.83 before finding support near $1,747 and rebounding above $1,771.

The biggest headwind currently facing Ethereum is the fallout from the Binance hack at the end of October. The attacker has transferred 78,415 ETH (worth approximately $142 million) to six newly created addresses and used THORChain to swap the ETH for BTC in an attempt to launder the funds. This massive potential sell-off hangs over the market like a sword of Damocles, severely undermining confidence. Meanwhile, spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net outflows of approximately $29.09 million on November 17, and CoinShares also liquidated its ETH holdings worth $16.6 million.

II. Technical Indicator Analysis

The moving averages are fully bearishly aligned, with the 7-day MA at $1,774, the 25-day MA at $1,798, and the 99-day MA at $1,809—all above the current price. The exponential moving averages likewise confirm a weak trend: the 7-day EMA is $1,775, the 25-day EMA is $1,793, and the 99-day EMA is as high as $1,831. The price is approximately $52 below the 99-day EMA, indicating a clear medium-term downtrend.

The Bollinger Bands show an upper band at $1,837.57, a middle band at $1,797.72, and a lower band at $1,757.87. The current price is between the lower and middle bands and has yet to break through the middle-band resistance, while the rebound remains limited.

The MACD continues to weaken, although the decline has eased somewhat. The latest histogram reading is -4.22, narrowing from -5.06 an hour earlier. The DIFF line is at -11.38 and the DEA line at -7.16. Both remain below the zero line, so the bearish trend is unchanged.

The RSI is showing signs of an oversold rebound. The 6-period RSI has risen sharply from an extremely low 8.94 to 39.80; the 12-period RSI is 39.01, and the 24-period RSI is 42.11. Although the RSI has moved out of extreme oversold territory, it has yet to enter neutral-to-strong territory (above 50), so the potential for further gains remains to be seen.

The KDJ indicator shows a clear recovery from the bottom, with a K value of 35.75, a D value of 30.90, and a J value of 45.46; all three lines are turning upward from low levels. The Williams indicator has also recovered from -81 to -55.04, likewise confirming a short-term recovery from oversold conditions. The ATR is 19.80, indicating that volatility remains elevated. The Parabolic SAR is above $1,825, and the Supertrend line is above $1,810; both continue to signal a bearish outlook.

III. Market Sentiment Analysis

Ethereum market sentiment is weighed down by several negative factors. First, continued hacker selling is creating an oversupply that is putting pressure on spot order books, and any rebound could face another wave of selling from the stolen funds. Second, institutional capital continues to flow out through ETFs, while the CoinShares liquidation has further deepened pessimistic market expectations.

Among the 15 quantitative factors, eight are bullish, six are bearish, and one is neutral, giving the bulls a slight edge. The composite indicator gives a bullish signal, with an overall win rate as high as 80.85%; the win rate for long positions is 75%, and for short positions it is 100%. 以太坊市场深度解析：黑客抛压与ETF资金外流双重夹击下的弱势震荡

一、价格走势分析

截至二零二六年十一月十八日UTC时间十七时，以太坊现货报价一千七百七十九点八四美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之一点二。从小时级别K线观察，ETH在过去五个交易时段内从一千七百九十美元附近持续走弱，最低触及一千七百三十二点八三美元，随后在一千七百四十七美元附近获得支撑并反弹至一千七百七十一美元上方。

以太坊当前面临的最大利空来自十月底币安黑客事件的后续影响。攻击者已将七万八千四百一十五枚ETH（价值约一亿四千二百万美元）转移至六个新创建的地址，并通过THORChain将ETH兑换为BTC进行洗币。这批巨额抛压如同悬在市场头顶的达摩克利斯之剑，严重压制了市场信心。与此同时，现货以太坊ETF在十一月十七日录得约二千九百零九万美元的净流出，CoinShares更是清算了其价值一千六百六十万美元的ETH库存。

二、技术指标解读

均线系统全面空头排列，七日均线一千七百七十四美元、二十五日均线一千七百九十八美元、九十九日均线一千八百零九美元均位于当前价格上方。指数移动平均线同样确认弱势格局，七日EMA为一千七百七十五美元，二十五日EMA为一千七百九十三美元，九十九日EMA高达一千八百三十一美元。价格与九十九日EMA之间存在约五十二美元的差距，中期下行趋势明显。

布林带指标显示，上轨为一千八百三十七点五七美元，中轨为一千七百九十七点七二美元，下轨为一千七百五十七点八七美元。当前价格在下轨与中轨之间运行，尚未突破中轨阻力，反弹力度有限。

MACD指标持续走弱但跌势有所放缓，最新柱状图为负四点二二，较前一小时的负五点零六有所收窄。DIFF线为负十一点三八，DEA线为负七点一六，双线均运行在零轴下方，空头格局未改。

RSI指标出现超卖反弹信号，六周期RSI从极低的八点九四大幅回升至三十九点八零，十二周期RSI为三十九点零一，二十四周期RSI为四十二点一一。虽然RSI已从极端超卖区域脱离，但仍未进入中性偏强区域（五十以上），反弹空间有待观察。

KDJ指标呈现明显的底部回升态势，K值三十五点七五，D值三十点九零，J值四十五点四六，三线均从低位向上发散。威廉指标从负八十一回升至负五十五点零四，同样确认短期超卖修复。ATR指标为一十九点八零，显示波动率仍然偏高。抛物线SAR位于一千八百二十五美元上方，超级趋势线位于一千八百一十美元上方，均维持看空信号。

三、市场情绪分析

以太坊市场情绪受到多重负面因素压制。首先，黑客持续抛售形成的供应过剩局面令现货订单簿承压，任何反弹都可能遭遇来自被盗资金的二次打击。其次，机构资金通过ETF渠道持续撤离，叠加CoinShares清仓事件，进一步加剧了市场的悲观预期。

从量化因子来看，十五个因子中有八个看多、六个看空、一个中性，多方略占优势。复合指标给出看多信号，整体胜率高达百分之八十点八五，其中做多胜率为百分之七十五，做空胜率为百分之百。这一数据表明，虽然当前处于弱势，但一旦出现趋势反转信号，做空的准确率极高，投资者需密切关注趋势变化。

链上数据显示，OBV指标为负九十五万七千八百五十二，较前一小时的负九十八万九千七百四十四有所改善，但仍处于深度负值区域，说明卖压虽有缓解但尚未根本扭转。

热门代币方面，MMT报价零点二四四三美元，二十四小时涨幅百分之六十七点二一；ZKC报价零点零三一美元，涨幅百分之三十四点六零；HUMA报价零点零零八九五美元，涨幅百分之二十点一三。

If Tether can’t prove that everything is in order, more scandals could emerge in the future. The stablecoin industry may face a shake-up, putting more pressure on companies with less transparency.

S&P’s downgrade is a clear warning sign for USDT. In the short term, USDT will likely need to hold above the psychological $63,000 level. 标普这次是直接点名Tether，说他们现在给USDT做的担保评估只能给"弱"这个等级。为啥呢？说白了就是标普怀疑Tether公布的储备资产（比如现金、债券、数字代币等）跟实际公布的USDT数量对得上号，而且这些资产是不是真的能随时换成现金来维持1:1的稳定。这个评级降得挺突然，直接让市场觉得，"哎呀，泰达币这个看似稳如泰山的1美元挂钩，其实可能没那么靠谱了"。虽然Tether一直坚称自己没问题，但标普这一下，就是给整个稳定币行业敲了个警钟。

- 中期：监管机构可能会更严格地盯紧所有稳定币公司，要求披露更多信息。如果Tether不能证明自己没问题，未来可能会有更多丑闻。整个稳定币行业可能要面临洗牌，那些透明度低的公司生存压力会更大。

标普这次评级下调，对USDT来说是个明确的压力信号。短期内USDT大概率要守在$63,000这个心理价位，如果跌破这个位置，那可能就不是小调整了。但话说回来，如果未来Tether能拿出足够透明的证据证明储备没问题，或者有新的机构出来为USDT背书，这个判断可能就需要改写了。毕竟现在加密市场啥情况，谁也说不准。

📰 How strong are expectations for a 50-basis-point Fed rate hike? Why has the Dollar Index surged to 103.91?

Fed official Waller publicly said a 50-basis-point rate hike was possible, sending the Dollar Index soaring to 103.91, its highest level since April 2025. Markets are pricing in a 97% probability of a 25-basis-point rate hike in December. This is hardly good news for cryptocurrencies, especially since a stronger dollar directly weighs on non-U.S. assets.

Why does this news matter?
Expectations for another Fed rate hike are heating up again, essentially because inflation data has continued to exceed expectations. Waller’s remarks show that concerns within the Fed about inflation “moving in the wrong direction” are growing. Although CPI is currently in line with expectations, core PPI remains elevated, signaling an overheated labor market. Behind the Dollar Index’s rise is a tug-of-war between the Fed and the market over “forceful policy”—either a 50-basis-point hike now or a stronger hawkish signal in the statement. This uncertainty is, ironically, making the market more inclined to accept the possibility of a 50-basis-point hike.

Impact on the market
The rising Dollar Index is putting direct pressure on other assets. There are three main channels through which this happens:
1. Premium for dollar-denominated assets: Investors holding dollars will sell non-U.S. assets to acquire dollars, putting Bitcoin and other dollar-denominated assets under selling pressure.
2. Spillover from bond-market pressure: Further increases in U.S. Treasury yields will push up borrowing costs for cryptocurrency funds.
3. Institutional fund flows: Tech stock funds have seen $1.7 billion in redemptions, indicating that money is starting to move out of high-valuation assets. Some of it may shift to safe-haven assets or crypto markets, but the amount is limited.

Historical cases show that when the Dollar Index breaks above 103, BTC prices typically pull back by 15%–20%, and this time is no exception.

title: 逐仓和全仓有什么区别？新手该用哪个？
subTitle:
开合约时会让你选「逐仓」或「全仓」，很多新手随手一点，结果吃了大亏。

【全仓】账户里所有余额都作为保证金。优点：强平价远，不容易被打爆；
缺点：一旦行情极端，亏损可能吃掉你整个账户。它是把所有鸡蛋放在一个
篮子里互相撑着。

【逐仓】只把指定的一笔钱分配给这个仓位。这个仓爆了，最多亏这一份，
不会传染到其他仓位和本金。风险被装进了笼子里。

【我的建议】新手一律逐仓。原因很简单：你还没有能力评估「一笔错单最坏
亏多少」，那就用制度帮你锁定最大损失。等你学会了仓位管理、连续三
个月稳定盈利，再考虑全仓也来得及。市场里活得久，比赚得快重要一百倍。

title: 爆仓价是怎么算出来的？一文看懂强平逻辑
subTitle:
开了合约之后，App上会显示一个「预估强平价」，这个数字怎么来的？

【简化算法】以10倍做多为例：本金100U，仓位1000U。当亏损吃掉你的保
证金（再扣掉维持保证金要求）时，触发强平。粗略说：全仓模式下，
强平距离 ≈ 1 / 杠杆倍数。10倍≈反向10%，5倍≈20%，20倍≈5%。

【为什么会插针】大波动时很多人集中爆仓，强平单涌向市场进一步砸价格，
形成连环爆——这就是为什么暴跌总带着长长的针。你的止损如果挂在大家
都在挂的位置，就会和他们的强平单一起被扫。

【实用结论】1. 杠杆越高，强平价越贴近现价，一点波动就出局；
2. 止损永远要设在自己的强平价之前，否则你连自己认错的机会都没有；
3. 看到长下影线别急着抄，那可能是别人的强平在给你表演。

Seeing a trending headline saying that investment funds will be allowed to hold cryptocurrency in 2027, don't assume that ordinary people will be able to buy a crypto-holding fund next year.

On November 18, the head of the Bank of Russia’s Investment Financial Intermediaries Department told RBC and “RBC Investments” on the sidelines of the Ural conference of the National Association of Securities Market Participants (NAUFOR) that the central bank is considering amending the relevant regulations next year to allow funds for qualified investors to buy cryptocurrency directly. She also noted that professional organizations have already submitted applications to the central bank to register such funds. The first funds to directly hold crypto assets could appear in 2027 only if the relevant amendments are approved and registered by the Ministry of Justice. Funds for non-qualified investors will not be opened up at this stage.

A few points that directly matter to ordinary people 👇

🔹 First, distinguish between two steps. On September 23, the central bank announced a directive, which was registered by the Ministry of Justice, allowing qualified investors’ funds to be invested in settlement instruments linked to cryptocurrency prices. These are cash-settled instruments; the tokens themselves are not delivered. What’s being discussed now goes a step further: allowing funds for qualified investors to hold cryptocurrency itself. This second step is still only a proposed amendment under consideration, not a rule that has already taken effect.

🔹 This is also a separate route from the rules for ordinary people buying crypto, which took effect on November 17. For now, non-qualified investors can buy Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT through regulated intermediaries, up to a maximum of 300,000 rubles per year through any one intermediary, and they must pass a test before trading. That rule is about buying crypto yourself; this proposal concerns fund products available only to qualified investors, and it still depends on the rules being finalized.

🔹 Officials have not yet explained which coins these funds will be allowed to buy, what position limits will apply, or how custody will be arranged. So it’s too early to interpret this as meaning “you’ll be able to subscribe to a Bitcoin fund as soon as 2027 begins.”

If you’re in Russia and already qualify as an investor, what matters more now is whether the amendments will be incorporated into the regulations and registered by the Ministry of Justice—not treating “proposed permission” as meaning that a product is already on sale. For ordinary people, the existing purchase limits and testing requirements have not been relaxed by this statement.

Which matters more to you: “funds for qualified investors may eventually be able to hold crypto directly,” or “this is still just a plan, and ordinary people aren’t included”?

content:
看到热榜写着2027年允许投资基金持有加密货币，先别理解成普通人明年就能买到一只持币基金。

11月18日，俄罗斯央行投资金融中介司司长在全国证券市场参与者协会（NAUFOR）乌拉尔会议场边，向 RBC 和「RBC投资」表示：央行在考虑明年修改相应规范性文件，让面向合格投资者的基金可以直接购买加密货币。她同时提到，已有专业机构向央行递交了这类基金的注册申请；只有相关修订获通过并经司法部登记后，第一批直接持有加密资产的基金才可能在2027年出现。面向非合格投资者的基金，这一阶段先不放开。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 先分清两步。9月23日央行已公布、并经司法部登记的指示，允许把合格投资者的资金投向与加密货币报价挂钩的结算类工具，也就是现金结算、并不直接交割代币。这次说的是更进一步：让合格投资者基金直接持有加密货币本身。后一步目前还只是在考虑中的修订，不是已经生效的规定。

🔹 这也和11月17日已经生效的普通人买币规则不是同一条通道。非合格投资者眼下仍是：可通过受监管中介购买比特币、以太坊和USDT，同一家中介一年最多30万卢布，交易前要先通过测试。那条是自己买币；这次说的是合格投资者才能参与的基金产品，而且还要等到规则落地。

🔹 官方目前没有说明这些基金能买哪些币、仓位上限怎么定、托管怎么安排。所以还不能把它理解成「2027年一开年就能申购某只比特币基金」。

如果人在俄罗斯、已经是合格投资者，现在更该盯修订会不会写进规范、会不会通过司法部登记，而不是把「拟允许」当成产品已经开卖。普通人这边，既有买币额度和测试要求并没有因为这条表态而放宽。

你更在意「合格投资者基金以后也许能直接持币」，还是更在意「这还只是规划，而且还不面向普通人」？

$BREV: The Discipline of Ignoring Setups Outside Your Chosen Timeframe

$BREV’s hourly direction is down while the price sits below support and volume is above its baseline. The observation raises a clear question: should a trader follow a setup that appears on a timeframe that is not their chosen focus?

A hypothetical decision would be to act on the hourly signal. Acting now means accepting a lower entry quality: the price may still be consolidating, and a sudden reversal could invalidate the trade before it moves. Alternatively, waiting for the daily trend to confirm would improve entry quality but risk chasing a move that never materializes.

Where the analogy helps: imagine a driver following a GPS that updates every minute versus a road map updated hourly. The GPS provides frequent corrections, but the map offers a stable plan. In trading, short‑term signals can be noisy; a single confirmation may mislead.

Where the analogy fails: the market’s volatility does not map neatly onto road speed. A short‑term reversal can happen before a daily trend settles, causing a loss that a wait‑and‑watch strategy would miss.

A counterexample is when daily support holds but hourly lows continue to break. If the daily support holds, the short‑term break is a false signal; acting on it would be a chase. If the daily support fails, a wait‑and‑watch loses the early exit.

The reassessment condition is simple: if the hourly change -2.22222% is more negative than the daily change -19.305%, and the relative volume 1.04x is above baseline, a short‑term breakout may be real. Otherwise, pause and seek higher‑timeframe confirmation.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

For a wider view: $ETH has hourly direction down and volume above its baseline; $MMT has hourly direction down and volume above its baseline. This alone does not establish correlation.

DBS partners with Circle to open USDC minting and redemption to institutions | ETH has yet to receive direct orders | 1777: manage risk first

My stance is to watch cautiously; for now, I’m not treating the stablecoin partnership as a signal to buy ETH spot. Binance Square is discussing #DBSAndCirclePartnerToExpandAsianInstitutionsUSDCAccess. I checked the announcements published separately by DBS and Circle on November 18: eligible institutional clients can mint and redeem USDC directly through DBS, with settlement between U.S. dollars and USDC supported around the clock and processed nearly instantly. The announcements describe institutional on- and off-ramps and liquidity arrangements. They do not disclose first-day transaction volume, specify that all transactions must go through Ethereum, or say that DBS has bought ETH.

What really matters to the market is the on-chain dollar on-ramp. If institutions can convert dollars to USDC more easily within the banking system, operational friction for trading, settlement, and treasury management may decrease. Which chain the funds ultimately use will determine network activity and demand for transaction fees. USDC runs on multiple chains, so the partnership itself supports only the view that “institutional stablecoin infrastructure is expanding”; it does not directly imply that ETH demand has already increased. I’ll keep tracking actual minting and redemption volumes, their distribution across chains, and whether usage persists—especially distinguishing one-off transfers from new usage.

The market has not yet provided strong confirmation either. Binance ETH/USDT is around $1,777.45, down about 0.40% over 24 hours, with a range of $1,732.83 to $1,836. Farside shows total net outflows of $29.1 million from U.S. spot ETH ETFs on November 17. The individual fund entries for November 18 are still blank; the total of 0.0 is just a data placeholder and should not be taken to mean that outflows have stopped. News interest is rising, but the price has yet to reclaim $1,800, and ETF flows have not shown a reversal. It’s better to treat this news as a framework for observation, not a reason to chase a rally.

If I were trading this myself, I wouldn’t enter now. I’d only consider spot or a low-risk long position, with a planned position-size cap of 2% of total capital and no high leverage. My entry trigger would be ETH reclaiming $1,800 and holding it on a one-hour retest, while BTC remains stable. If the move is just a sudden spike without a retest, I’ll stay out. The first target is $1,836, where I’d take half off; the second is around $1,870, where I’d reduce most of the remainder. I’d place the stop below $1,760. If the price breaks below the $1,733 range low, I’d close the entire position and wouldn’t average down. If later disclosures show that USDC usage is concentrated in bank ledgers or on other chains, while ETH continues to underperform the broader market, that would invalidate this thesis about potential on-chain benefits, and I’d abandon the plan. Before trading, wait for the facts and price action to align; discipline matters more than the narrative.

市场目前也没有给出强确认。我查到的币安ETH/USDT约1777.45美元，24小时下跌约0.40%，区间1732.83至1836美元。Farside显示11月17日美国现货ETH ETF合计净流出2910万美元；11月18日各基金栏仍为空，合计0.0只是数据占位，不能当成资金停止流出。新闻热度在升，但价格尚未收复1800，ETF资金也未证明转向。这里更适合把消息当作观察框架，而不是追涨理由。

I. Analysis of Ethereum Market Trends

As of 4:00 p.m. UTC on November 18, 2026, Ethereum was trading at $1,749, having accelerated its decline over the past several hours. The price fell steadily from a high of $1,795, reaching a low of $1,732, a drop of approximately 3.5%. Trading volume rose significantly during the decline. The trading value for the hour from 3:00 p.m. UTC reached $62.15 million, the highest hourly volume in recent times, indicating clear panic selling in the market.

According to the Bollinger Bands, the price has fallen below the lower band at $1,758 and entered technically oversold territory. The middle band is at $1,799, while the upper band has extended to $1,839. The continued widening of the bands indicates a sharp increase in volatility. Ethereum's drop below the lower band is similar to Bitcoin's, with a clear short-term oversold signal. However, when the bearish trend is strong, the price may continue to track along the lower band.

II. In-Depth Interpretation of Technical Indicators

The moving average system shows a clear bearish alignment. The 7-period moving average has fallen to $1,776, the 25-period moving average is at $1,798, and the 99-period moving average is at $1,809. The price is below all moving averages, and the short-term averages have begun turning downward, confirming a bearish short- to medium-term trend. Exponential moving averages likewise confirm the bearish setup: the 7-period EMA is $1,773, the 25-period EMA is $1,794, and the price is well below all moving average support levels.

As for the MACD, the DIFF line has fallen to -12.00, the DEA line is at -6.27, and the histogram is at -5.73 and continuing to widen. The MACD is diverging downward at an accelerating pace below the zero line, indicating strong bearish momentum. The 6-period RSI has fallen to 23.42, entering extremely oversold territory. Notably, the RSI has rebounded from 8.94 in the previous hour, suggesting that the most extreme oversold conditions have eased slightly, although it remains at a low level overall.

For the KDJ indicator, K is 25.27, D is 27.06, and J is 21.68. All three lines are at low levels but show signs of a slight rebound. The Williams %R (WR) is -71.16, also in oversold territory. The 14-period ATR is 18.57, indicating a large price range. The OBV indicator continues to decline, reaching -989,000, indicating ongoing capital outflows.

III. Market Sentiment and News Analysis

Ethereum is currently facing several bearish factors. First, spot Ethereum ETFs recorded net outflows of $29.1 million on November 17, extending the trend of sustained institutional withdrawals. Second, the impact of the Binance security incident on October 29 continues to unfold. The 78,415 ETH transferred by the attackers (worth approximately $142 million) is being laundered through cross-chain bridges, creating significant supply pressure in the spot market.

There are also unfavorable signals at the corporate level. title: 杠杆到底是啥？100U怎么撬动1000U，代价是什么
subTitle:
很多刚进场的朋友问我：10倍杠杆是不是就是赚10倍？今天用大白话讲清楚。

【本质】杠杆是交易所借钱给你开仓。你有100U本金，开10倍杠杆，实际控
制的是1000U的仓位。币价涨1%，你的本金赚10%（相对本金）；反过来，
跌1%，本金亏10%——注意，亏损是按你借来的总仓位算的。

【代价】10倍杠杆下，币价反向走约10%，你的本金就归零，这叫爆仓。不是
跌10%才亏完，是跌约10%就全部没了（准确点位还和保证金率有关）。
杠杆放大的不是你的胜率，是波动。方向对，它加速你赚钱；方向错，它加速
你出局。工具没好坏，取决于你有没有把它当工具，而不是当赌具。

【新手建议】先用2-3倍感受波动，把止损练成肌肉记忆，再谈放大。

translatedData.title: What exactly is leverage? How can 100U control 1,000U, and what’s the cost?
translatedData.subTitle:
A lot of people who are new to trading ask me: Does 10x leverage mean you make 10 times as much? Today, I’ll explain it in plain English.

【The basics】Leverage means the exchange lends you money to open a position. If you have 100U in principal and use 10x leverage, you’re effectively controlling a position worth
1,000U. If the coin’s price rises by 1%, you make 10% on your principal. Conversely,
A 1% drop means a 10% loss on your principal—note that the loss is calculated based on your total borrowed position.

【The cost】With 10x leverage, if the price moves against you by about 10%, your principal is wiped out. This is called liquidation. It doesn’t mean
you only lose everything after a 10% drop; a drop of about 10% is enough to wipe it all out (the exact price also depends on the margin ratio).

假设一个策略胜率60%，对了赚50%，错了亏50%。听上去不错吧？
如果每次满仓，算一下长期结果：60%×50% - 40%×50% = 每笔期望+10%，
看着是正期望。但注意路径：连错两次就是-75%，需要+300%才能回本。
正期望的策略+满仓执行=大概率破产，这就是赌徒破产定理在币圈的
日常上演。

同样的策略，改成每次只动20%仓位：连错两次-18%，毫无杀伤力，
长期期望照吃。策略没变，变的只是仓位，生死就不同。

记住这个不等式：你的长期收益 ≈ 策略期望 × 你能活多久。仓位决定
后者。活得久的人，才有资格谈期望值。

translatedData.title: Trading Insights | The Math Behind Going All In—Would You Still Dare After Reading This?
translatedData.subTitle:
Suppose a strategy has a 60% win rate, earning 50% when you’re right and losing 50% when you’re wrong. Sounds pretty good, right?
If you go all in every time, here’s the long-term expectation: 60% × 50% - 40% × 50% = an expected gain of 10% per trade,
It looks like a positive expectation. But consider the path: two losses in a row mean a 75% loss, and you’d need a 300% gain to break even.
A positive-expectation strategy + going all in = a high probability of bankruptcy. This is the gambler’s ruin theorem playing out in crypto
every day.

Same strategy, but risk only 20% of your capital each time: two losses in a row = -18%, barely a dent,
while still capturing the long-term expected returns. The strategy hasn’t changed; only the position size has—and that makes all the difference between survival and ruin.

There’s not much to say today, so let’s talk about something else.

There’s a lesson in *The Most Important Thing*:
Howard Marks talks about second-level thinking: When others see prices rising and rush to buy, you should ask yourself: Who’s selling? Why are they selling? First-level thinking makes you follow the crowd; second-level thinking keeps you from being left holding the bag.

Let’s take $ETH  today as an example: It’s at 1,748 right now, down 1.68% in 24 hours. This market action is a perfect illustration of the lesson above. It’s no coincidence—it’s human nature repeating itself in the markets.

It sounds simple, but it takes a lot of expensive lessons to put into practice.
Keeping some powder dry is better than anything else.

#ETH #投资哲学 #交易心态 #Crypto

Being added to the Central Bank’s register doesn’t mean you can open the Alfa-Bank app today and buy crypto.

On November 18, the Bank of Russia announced its decision to add Alfa-Bank (official legal name: АО「АЛЬФА-БАНК」, tax ID 7728168971) to the register of entities engaged in digital currency exchange, confirming that it is authorized to conduct this business. The information was posted at 14:06 Moscow time that day. The “crypto trading register” trending online refers to this register of exchange entities—not the launch of an exchange or a custody license.

A few points directly relevant to ordinary users👇

🔹 Being added to the register grants authorization to conduct exchange activities. Under the Central Bank’s definition, these entities can act as buyers or sellers themselves, trading digital currencies over the counter with individuals or companies, and can also make markets in organized trading. It is not a notice that a “buy crypto” button is already live in the app.

🔹 The register snapshot at midnight on the 18th still listed 30 entities, and Alfa-Bank was not among them. That matches the fact that the decision to add it was announced only that afternoon: under the rules, the updated register must be published no later than the next business day.

🔹 It was added only to the register of exchange entities. As of midnight that same day, Alfa-Bank was also not yet listed in the register of digital custody entities.

If you’re in Russia and want to use this bank’s official exchange channel in the future, you’ll still have to wait for the bank to make it available and confirm that the provider is a regulated exchange entity. Even once it’s available, non-qualified investors remain subject to the existing rules: they can buy Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT, up to 300,000 rubles a year through the same intermediary, and must pass a test and read the risk disclosure before trading.

Which matters more to you: “another major bank has received exchange authorization,” or “there may still be a wait between getting authorization and actually being able to buy through the app”?

#俄罗斯央行将AlfaBank纳入加密交易登记册 #BTC #ETH

content:
进了央行名册，还不等于你今天打开阿尔法银行 App 就能买币。

11月18日，俄罗斯央行公布决定：把阿尔法银行（官方全称 АО「АЛЬФА-БАНК」，税号 7728168971）写入「从事数字货币兑换的机构」名册，并确认它有权开展这项业务。官方信息当天莫斯科时间 14:06 挂出。热榜上的「加密交易登记册」，指的就是这份兑换机构名册，不是交易所开盘，也不是托管牌照。

几个和普通人直接相关的点👇

🔹 写进名册，拿到的是开展兑换业务的资格。按央行的界定，这类机构可以自己作为买方或卖方，在场外与个人或公司买卖数字货币，也可以在组织化交易里做市。它不是「App 已经上线买币按钮」的通知。

🔹 官方 18 日 0 点的名册快照里还是 30 家，里面还没有阿尔法银行。这和当天下午才公布的写入决定对得上：更新后的名册按规定不晚于下一工作日公布。

🔹 写入的只是兑换机构名册。同一天 0 点的「数字托管机构」名册里，目前也还没有阿尔法银行。

如果人在俄罗斯、以后想走这家银行的正规兑换通道，还得等银行自己把入口开出来，并确认对方就是受监管的兑换机构。即便开通，非合格投资者眼下仍按既有规则：可买的是比特币、以太坊和 USDT，通过同一家中介一年最多买 30 万卢布，交易前要先通过测试、阅读风险说明。

你更在意「又一家正规大行拿到兑换资格」，还是更在意「资格到手和 App 真正能买，中间可能还要等」？

💥Binance exchange's 24H #Bitcoin Liquidity Heatmap Update. Technical considerations and tips in the audio below this post.

The hacker who hacked the Binance exchange transferred 74.881 ETH, equivalent to more than US$137 million, across different wallets. Despite this movement, most of the funds stolen during the October incident remain immobilized in the original reserves.

Around 18,362 Bitcoin remain unlaundered, and nearly 632.000 ETH remain untouched in the hacker's wallets. Security and on-chain analytics firms continue to closely monitor these wallets for any attempts to bridge or convert funds through decentralized protocols and instant exchange services.

💥The U.S. Dollar Index, or DXY, reached 103,77 today, its highest level since April 2025. A stronger dollar usually puts pressure on Bitcoin.

According to CryptoQuant's head of research, Julio Moreno, Bitcoin holders realized a net loss of 25.800 BTC, the highest figure in approximately four months, since July 13, 2026. Unlike unrealized losses, this figure measures BTC that was actually moved or sold at a price below its original purchase price, far exceeding profit-taking.

Historically, sharp spikes in realized losses reflect episodes of investor capitulation under financial stress. Although this phenomenon is often observed near local market bottoms, when selling pressure runs out, Moreno warns that this figure alone does not confirm that selling has peaked.

A diferencia de las pérdidas no realizadas, esta cifra mide los BTC que efectivamente fueron movidos o vendidos a un precio inferior al de su adquisición original, superando ampliamente a las tomas de ganancias.

Históricamente, los picos pronunciados en las pérdidas realizadas reflejan episodios de capitulación de inversores bajo estrés financiero. Aunque este fenómeno suele observarse cerca de los suelos locales del mercado cuando se agota la presión vendedora, Moreno advierte que el dato por sí solo no confirma que las ventas hayan tocado techo.

[Title: Institutions Bet on a New Play? Why Is the Value of BTC Accumulation Being Redefined?]

Anchorage clients can use BTC held in bank custody as collateral, lowering the barrier for institutions to participate in Kalshi.

Anchorage and Kalshi Prime have teamed up on something new: institutional clients can now use the BTC and stablecoins they hold in custody at Anchorage Digital Bank as collateral to trade futures on the Kalshi platform. Put simply, there’s no need to transfer the crypto directly to the platform as collateral—as long as you have proof of custody from a regulated bank. This makes things a lot more convenient for institutions, since handing their crypto over to a third-party custodian can feel a bit unsettling. And because Kalshi is regulated by the CFTC, trading there offers greater peace of mind. This effectively opens a new door for institutions to participate in the Bitcoin derivatives market.

Market impact
- Short term: This could boost institutional interest in the BTC derivatives market and potentially bring some over-the-counter capital into related futures contracts, providing moderate support for BTC prices. With the barrier to entry now lower, institutions that previously hesitated to commit significant capital can dip their toes in.
- Medium term: More importantly, this could accelerate Bitcoin’s financialization. Institutions may be more likely to use BTC as collateral for increasingly complex trades, such as arbitrage and hedging. This could gradually raise BTC’s importance within the broader financial system and have a far-reaching impact on the industry landscape.

My take
This is bullish for BTC, but don’t expect an immediate surge. It reflects Bitcoin’s transition from digital gold to a financial instrument within a regulatory framework. In the short term, we may see a moderate increase in futures open interest, indirectly supporting spot prices. But keep in mind that this model is still in limited pilot use, and widespread adoption will take time. Don’t be too harsh if I’m wrong—I’m only trying it with a small position myself. I’m about 70% confident in this take; I’ll leave the remaining 30% to the market.

[标题：机构押注新玩法？为什么 BTC 增持价值要被重新定义？]

Anchorage 客户能用银行托管 BTC 当保证金，机构参与 Kalshi 的门槛降低了。

Anchorage 和 Kalshi Prime 联手搞了个新花样：机构客户现在可以把他们放在 Anchorage 银行里保管的那堆 BTC 和稳定币，当作保证金去 Kalshi 平台上交易期货。简单说，就是不用把币直接交给平台做担保，只要你有合规银行的托管凭证就行。这事儿对机构来说省心不少，毕竟把币交给第三方存管总有点不放心。而且 Kalshi 平台受 CFTC 监管，交易起来更踏实。这相当于给机构参与比特币衍生品市场开了一扇新大门。

对市场的影响
- 短期：这会提升机构对 BTC 衍生品市场的兴趣，可能带动一部分场外资金流入相关期货合约，给 BTC 价格带来温和支撑。因为现在参与门槛低了，以前不敢玩大钱的机构现在也能试水。
- 中期：更关键的是，这会加速比特币金融化进程。未来机构用 BTC 作为抵押品进行更多复杂交易的可能性增大，比如做套利、对冲等操作。这会潜移默化提升 BTC 在整个金融体系里的重要性，对行业格局有深远影响。

我的判断
这事儿对 BTC 算是利多，但别想太多直接暴涨。它体现了监管框架下，比特币从数字黄金向金融工具的过渡。短期内可能看到期货合约持仓量温和增加，对现货价格形成间接支撑。但要注意，这种模式现在还处于小范围试点，大规模应用需要时间。说错轻喷，我自己也就小仓位试试，这判断我有七成把握，剩下三成交给市场。

Visa expands stablecoin cross-border prefunding to Asia Pacific and launches dtcpay pilot

Visa has taken another step toward integrating stablecoins into the funding side of cross-border payments. On November 18, Visa announced plans to make stablecoin prefunding available to eligible customers in Asia Pacific: customers can use supported stablecoins to pre-fund cross-border payments through Visa Direct, its real-time money movement platform, while recipients continue to receive funds in fiat currency. Availability varies by customer eligibility and region. In Asia Pacific, Visa is piloting the service with Singapore-based digital payments company dtcpay, connecting stablecoins to the prefunding process through independently provided digital asset infrastructure.

The timeline points to a gradual rollout: in 2021, Visa partnered with Crypto.com to pilot card transaction settlement in USDC on Ethereum; in 2025, it launched stablecoin prefunding and payment pilots through Visa Direct; and in October 2026, the service entered commercial operation with U.S. provider Inyo Global, marking the first time Visa confirmed that stablecoin prefunding had moved from testing to live operations. The Asia Pacific expansion is the next step in bringing the capability to more markets after its U.S. launch.

At the operational level, prefunding and settlement are two separate stages. Prefunding means that a customer deposits funds with Visa before a transaction is settled, allowing outgoing payments to be made without waiting for individual traditional clearing processes. Traditional cross-border prefunding relies on fiat wire transfers and is constrained by bank business hours, intermediary fees, and correspondent banking chains. Switching to stablecoins moves the funding step on-chain, which in theory allows it to take place around the clock. For Visa, this connects digital assets to its money movement network, which covers more than 1.8 billion endpoints; for business customers, it offers greater flexibility in managing short-term liquidity and arranging payment funding.

The impact on crypto markets can be considered along three paths. First, expanded use cases: Visa is the world's largest card network by transaction volume, and its acceptance of stablecoins as assets for funding ahead of settlement opens up an institutional-grade use case for issuers. Industry data from the middle of this year put the total stablecoin market capitalization at about $325 billion, including approximately $76 billion in USDC. Second, competitive ripple effects: Mastercard, Stripe, and others are investing more in stablecoin infrastructure, and industry media have previously reported plans by several major payment networks to jointly develop a stablecoin platform. Third, regulatory screening: as the U.S. stablecoin legislative framework coincides with the end of the EU MiCA transition period, issuers with transparent reserves that comply with regulations are more likely to qualify.

It is important to distinguish confirmed facts from speculation: Visa has officially announced the arrangement, but it has not disclosed the list of eligible customers, the stablecoins supported, transaction limits, or actual transaction volumes, so its commercial scale cannot yet be assessed. The editorial view is that infrastructure deployment generally precedes the emergence of transaction data. Stablecoins' role in cross-border payments is shifting from narrative to operational reality; subsequent Visa financial disclosures and the pace of pilot expansion will be two indicators for assessing the depth of adoption.

content:
Visa将稳定币跨境预注资扩展至亚太并启动dtcpay试点

把稳定币嵌入跨境支付的资金环节，Visa又向前迈了一步。11月18日，Visa宣布计划面向亚太地区符合条件的客户开放稳定币预注资功能：客户可使用受支持的稳定币，通过实时资金流转平台Visa Direct为跨境付款预先注资，收款方仍以法币收款，可用性因客户资格与地区而异。在亚太，Visa正与新加坡数字支付公司dtcpay开展试点，由独立提供的数字资产基础设施完成稳定币与预注资流程的对接。

从时间线看，这是一条渐进路线：2021年，Visa与Crypto.com合作，在以太坊上以USDC试点卡交易结算；2025年，通过Visa Direct启动稳定币预注资与付款试点；2026年10月，该功能与美国服务商Inyo Global合作进入商业运营，Visa首次确认将稳定币预注资从测试推进到实际运营。本次亚太扩展，是该能力继美国落地后走向更多市场的下一步。

机制层面，预注资与结算是两个环节：预注资指客户在交易结算前先将资金存放于Visa，使出账支付无需等待逐笔传统清算。传统跨境预注资依赖法币电汇，受银行营业时间、中介费用与代理行链条限制；改用稳定币后，资金步骤移至链上，理论上可全天候完成。对Visa而言，这把数字资产接入其覆盖超过180亿个端点的资金网络；对企业客户而言，短期流动性管理与付款资金安排更灵活。

对加密市场的影响可沿三条路径观察。其一，用例扩容：Visa按交易量计是全球最大卡网络，其接受稳定币作为结算前资金资产，为发行方开辟机构级场景，今年年中行业统计显示稳定币总市值约3250亿美元，其中USDC约760亿美元。其二，竞争传导：万事达卡、Stripe等均在加码稳定币基础设施，行业媒体此前还报道过几大支付网络联合筹建稳定币平台的计划。其三，合规筛选：美国稳定币立法框架与欧盟MiCA过渡期结束相叠加，储备透明、符合监管的发行方更可能入围。

需要区分事实与推测：上述安排为Visa官方宣布，但合格客户名单、支持的稳定币种类、交易限额与实际流量均未披露，目前无法评估其商业规模。编辑观察认为，基础设施落地通常先于流量数据出现，稳定币在跨境支付中的角色正从叙事走向运营现实，后续Visa财报披露与试点扩围节奏，将是判断采用深度的两个坐标。

截至二零二六年十一月十八日，以太坊现货价格报一千七百七十四美元，过去二十四小时下跌约百分之二点六，跌幅明显大于比特币。价格从一千八百零七美元附近持续走低，先后跌穿多条均线和布林带下轨，最低触及一千七百五十六美元。从小时线来看，以太坊在近期出现了一波显著的放量下跌，单小时成交额突破五千万美元，是此前正常时段的一千五百万至一千六百万美元的三倍以上，表明恐慌性抛售情绪浓厚。

以太坊近期面临多重利空因素。现货ETF连续三个交易日录得资金流出，最近一次单日流出达两千九百零九万美元。CoinShares宣布清仓其全部价值一千六百六十万美元的以太坊持仓用于股票回购，进一步加剧了现货市场的抛压。此外，生态系统中多个DeFi协议遭受攻击，累计损失超过一千三百四十万美元，打击了智能合约信心，可能导致流动性进一步外流。

二、技术指标解读

以太坊的技术指标同样呈现深度超卖状态。RSI六周期指标降至十四点三六，已经低于比特币的超卖程度，RSI十二周期为二十九点六七，RSI二十四周期为三十九点三六。随机RSI指标连续多个周期归零，超卖程度极为罕见。KDJ指标中K值为二十五点三五，D值为三十点七五，J值为十四点五五，均处于低位。

Standardizing Entry Signals on $ETH

Why does a down hourly candle with volume 2.00x baseline on $ETH feel urgent? The observation shows a bearish direction while volume exceeds the baseline, prompting a question about entry quality versus chasing.

The baseline scenario assumes the candle’s price moved below the recent support level, and the relative volume suggests stronger participation than the norm. A trader could interpret this as a clear invalidation of the prior bullish bias, choosing a tighter entry near the support line. The alternative is to wait for a confirming rebound, accepting a potentially weaker entry but reducing the risk of being caught in a false breakdown.

Imagine a thought experiment: two identical traders watch the same candle. Trader A places a limit order just above the support, hoping to capture a quick bounce. Trader B waits for a confirmed reversal pattern on the next hourly candle before entering. If the price continues down, Trader A may face a larger stop loss distance, while Trader B might miss the optimal price but preserve capital. The trade‑off centers on entry quality versus the cost of chasing.

A practical self‑check is to ask: does the next closed candle show a higher low or a reversal in direction? If the price forms a higher low, the earlier entry loses its edge, suggesting the waiting approach was safer. Conversely, a continued lower low validates the aggressive entry. This conditional reassessment keeps risk aligned with the observed volume spike and directional bias without assuming any hidden market intent.

Probabilistic market research, not a recommendation or guaranteed return.

【If ETH falls to 1,722, what would really break?】

Let’s take an extreme scenario: ETH plunges to 1,722, while the Fear Index sits at just 11. My view: before rushing to ask whether this is the bottom, first ask whether demand for ETH as a settlement and security layer is still there.

ETH isn’t a lottery ticket; it’s more like a pass to use a highway. Users pay for block space when they transfer funds, submit transactions, or collateralize assets. Validators maintain the network, and the security budget is tied to the amount staked and fees consumed. A price drop hurts return expectations, but it doesn’t mean the chain will grind to a halt. Those who focus only on the coin’s price may miss the native demand generated by network use.

In practical terms: CoinShares selling all its treasury ETH and halving its SOL holdings for buybacks suggests that institutions view ETH as a liquid asset. ETH holders bear the volatility, while protocols and users that rely on ETH for settlement care more about fees, liquidity, and the security budget. The business model works, but whether the price can reflect demand depends on real usage, not slogans.

1,722 is a level to watch, not an automatic buy-the-dip signal. ETH is down 64% from its peak, so it’s undeniably cheaper; as long as fees, staking, and demand from applications haven’t collapsed, only time can reveal where the bottom is.

Remember: a low price doesn’t mean an asset is undervalued. First, look at whether people are consistently willing to pay to use it.

What do you think matters most to watch in ETH’s next phase: fees, staking yields, or real-world applications?

translatedData.title: ETH and Gas Fees: What Are a Blockchain’s Fuel Costs?
translatedData.subTitle:
You have to pay gas fees to transfer funds or mint an NFT. Who gets that money?

【The essence】Ethereum is a globally shared computer. Every operation (transfers, trades, running
smart contracts) uses computing resources. Gas is what you pay the validators who perform those computations for you.
“Fuel costs.” The more congested the network, the more people compete to get their transactions processed, and the higher the gas price (the gas fee per unit).

【Why it’s related to the coin price】A booming market → a surge in on-chain transactions → gas fees skyrocket. That’s why experienced users
have a habit: they do on-chain transactions late at night or when the market is quiet. The same transaction can cost half as much.

无归。所以：大额资金别长期躺在单一稳定币里，分散是免费的保险。

📰 Miner income falls back to 2011 levels: What is Bitcoin’s real strength?

Bitcoin miners’ income this year is at its lowest level since 2011, directly hurting their profitability. A decline in miner income could lead miners to scale back mining. If mining activity decreases, the security of the Bitcoin network could be affected, which in turn could affect Bitcoin’s long-term value.

Why does this news matter?
The main reason for the decline in miner income is that both Bitcoin transaction fees and block rewards are falling. Bitcoin’s block reward is halved every four years as part of the protocol’s design, intended to simulate scarcity. Meanwhile, as the price of Bitcoin rises, transaction volume has declined relatively, leading to lower transaction fees. Together, these two factors have significantly reduced miners’ income. This means mining activity may slow, which could affect the security and stability of the Bitcoin network.

Market impact
The short-term market impact of falling miner income could be negative, as miners may scale back mining activity. This could reduce the supply of Bitcoin and, in turn, drive prices higher. Over the long term, however, if miner income remains depressed, some less efficient miners may be forced to leave the market. This could improve overall mining efficiency and have a positive effect on network security. In addition, falling miner income may prompt miners to seek cheaper energy, potentially putting some downward pressure on energy prices.

Trading outlook
The market impact of falling miner income is complex. In the short term, it may negatively affect market sentiment, but over the long term it could have a positive effect on network security. One key point to watch is whether persistently low miner income leads to a reduction in the supply of Bitcoin, which could push prices higher. However, if falling miner income causes large numbers of miners to leave the market, this could also negatively affect network security. Therefore, it is important to closely monitor changes in miner income and their impact on the security of the Bitcoin network.

📰 矿工收入跌回2011年：比特币的底气到底在哪儿？

比特币矿工今年的收入是自2011年以来最低的，这直接打击了他们的盈利能力。矿工收入下降意味着矿工可能减少挖矿，如果挖矿活动减少，比特币网络的安全性可能会受到影响，这反过来又可能影响比特币的长期价值。

为什么这条新闻重要？
矿工收入下降的根本原因是比特币的交易费用和区块奖励都在减少。比特币的区块奖励每四年减半一次，这是比特币协议设计的一部分，旨在模拟稀缺性。同时，随着比特币价格上涨，交易量相对减少，导致交易费用下降。这两方面因素叠加，使得矿工的收入大幅减少。这意味着矿工的挖矿活动可能放缓，这又可能影响比特币网络的安全性和稳定性。

对市场的影响
矿工收入下降对市场的短期影响可能是负面的，因为矿工可能会减少挖矿活动，这可能导致比特币的供应减少，从而推动价格上涨。然而，从长期来看，如果矿工收入持续低迷，可能会迫使一些效率较低的矿工退出市场，这可能会提高整体的挖矿效率，从而对网络的安全性产生积极影响。此外，矿工收入下降也可能促使矿工寻找更便宜的能源，这可能对能源价格产生一定的压力。

操作思路
矿工收入下降对市场的影响是复杂的，短期内可能会对市场情绪产生负面影响，但长期来看可能会对网络的安全性产生积极影响。值得关注的重点是，如果矿工收入持续低迷，可能会导致比特币的供应减少，从而推动价格上涨。然而，如果矿工收入下降导致矿工大量退出市场，这也可能对网络的安全性产生负面影响。因此，需要密切关注矿工收入的变化，以及这对比特币网络安全性的影响。
